additionalInfo.description: Rule chain xử lý automation rules cho SmartHome. Lắng nghe telemetry từ devices, đọc automation rules từ Home Asset attribute, evaluate conditions và execute actions (RPC to devices).
Phân loại message: telemetry, attribute update, RPC, etc.
Chi xu ly message tu devices, bo qua messages tu assets
Them device info vao metadata de su dung trong cac node tiep theo
Tim Home Asset (parent cua Room chua Device) va doc server attribute 'automations'. Relation chain: Home CONTAINS Room CONTAINS Device, nen maxLevel=3 de tim nguoc tu Device len Home.
Chi tiep tuc neu Home Asset co automation rules

Core engine: doc automation rules, evaluate tat ca conditions (device_state, time_range, time_schedule, day_of_week, device_offline), va tra ve triggered actions. Moi lan device gui telemetry, node nay chay va kiem tra tat ca rules.
Chi tiep tuc neu co automation rule duoc trigger
Tach danh sach actions tu triggered rules thanh tung action de xu ly tuan tu
Route moi action toi node xu ly tuong ung: device_command, delay, notification, run_scene
Chuyen action device_command thanh RPC request co the gui toi device
Gui RPC command toi target device. Device ID lay tu metadata.targetDeviceId. Timeout 30s.
Delay action: cho X giay truoc khi thuc hien action tiep theo. Delay value doc tu msg.seconds.
Chuyen action send_notification thanh notification payload
Tao alarm tu notification action. App se doc alarms va hien thi push notification qua Firebase.
Tao log entry cho moi automation execution. Log duoc luu vao Home Asset telemetry key 'automation_log'.
Luu automation log vao telemetry cua Home Asset. TTL 30 ngay.
Log failure khi RPC call that bai
Luu failure log vao telemetry. TTL 30 ngay.
Node xu ly scheduler heartbeat - lay thong tin device gui heartbeat
